providers.lead: LLM provider status as the worker last saw it. The key is never set or shown here.
providers.dataFlowTitle: Data sent to the Claude Platform API
providers.dataFlow: To run agents, KodeKantor sends relevant code snippets, your instructions, tool result summaries and log excerpts to the Claude Platform API (Anthropic). Secret files (.env, keys, credentials), dependency/build folders and paths in .agentignore are never sent; detected secrets are masked. Admins can disable the provider in Settings → Providers & models. Provider calls can also be stopped per project through the project settings (through the API for now; the screen comes later).

enabled.help: While disabled, agents may not call this provider in any project. Smoke tests can still run to check it.

smoke.rateLimited: Too many smoke tests. Try again later.
smoke.noAnswer: The outcome of the request is unknown (no readable answer from the server). The smoke test may still be running; its status is read from readiness.

smoke.readFailed: Readiness could not be read while waiting for the smoke test.

smoke.unconfirmed: A newer report exists than the one shown when you pressed the button, but it is not certain it came from your smoke test. Check the audit.
smoke.noRun: No smoke test is running and there is no new report. The request may not have reached the server, or the run ended without a report. Check the audit, then try again.
smoke.unreadable: Cannot check whether the smoke test finished: readiness keeps failing to load.
